from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
t=df['t'].values;A=df['A'].values;y=df['dA_dt'].values
FA={}
for p in [-1,-0.5,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3]: FA['A^%g'%p]=A**p
for k in [0.2,0.5,1,2]:
    FA['exp(-%g A)'%k]=np.exp(-k*A); FA['1/(1+%gA)'%k]=1/(1+k*A)
FA['1']=np.ones_like(A); FA['logA']=np.log(A)
FT={}
for q in [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,1.5,2]: FT['t^%g'%q]=t**q
for k in [0.1,0.2,0.5,1]:
    FT['exp(-%g t)'%k]=np.exp(-k*t)
names=[];P=[]
for a,fa in FA.items():
    for b,fb in FT.items():
        names.append(a+' * '+b); P.append(fa*fb)
P=np.array(P)
pairs=np.array(list(itertools.combinations(range(len(P)),2)))
yy=y@y; tot=np.sum((y-y.mean())**2)
def sse_pair(c,i,j):
    Z=np.vstack([np.sqrt(t),np.log(1+c*A)*t,P[i],P[j]]).T
    cf,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,y,rcond=None)
    return np.sum((y-Z@cf)**2)/tot, cf
# coarse c grid, keep top 40 (pair,c)
cands=[]
for c in np.exp(np.linspace(np.log(0.3),np.log(100),40)):
    b2=np.log(1+c*A)*t
    Z=np.vstack([np.sqrt(t),b2,P]); M=Z@Z.T; r=Z@y
    I=np.stack([np.zeros(len(pairs),int),np.ones(len(pairs),int),2+pairs[:,0],2+pairs[:,1]],1)
    G=M[I[:,:,None],I[:,None,:]]; rhs=r[I]
    sol=np.linalg.solve(G+1e-10*np.eye(4),rhs[...,None])[...,0]
    sse=(yy-np.sum(sol*rhs,1))/tot
    for k in np.argsort(sse)[:3]:
        cands.append((sse[k],c,pairs[k,0],pairs[k,1]))
cands.sort()
out=[]
for e,c,i,j in cands[:40]:
    f=lambda lc: sse_pair(np.exp(lc),i,j)[0]
    r=minimize_scalar(f,bounds=(np.log(c)-0.2,np.log(c)+0.2),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-10})
